stories.title: Sources: Seattle, Witherspoon reach $132M deal
stories.summary: The Seahawks and Pro Bowl cornerback Devon Witherspoon have reached an agreement on a four-year, $132 million extension, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

stories.title: Cardinals RB Love to miss a week with sore ankle
stories.summary: Cardinals rookie running back Jeremiyah Love will miss the next week to let a sore ankle he injured Thursday night against the Raiders heal, coach Mike LaFleur said Saturday.

stories.title: Scrutiny of WNBA a result of success, icons say
stories.summary: Some the WNBA's greatest players believe the increased discourse and scrutiny of the league is the result of the growth and success of the women's game.

stories.title: Clark-Bueckers clash lives up to hype in Fever win
stories.summary: Caitlin Clark and Paige Bueckers went blow for blow with dueling 29-point performances, with Clark's Fever coming out on top 98-87 against Bueckers' short-handed Wings.

stories.title: Tua 'frustrated' by play in Falcons' preseason loss
stories.summary: Falcons quarterback Tua Tagovailoa said he was "frustrated and disappointed" after a preseason loss to the Broncos, during which he played two series and was 3-of-5 passing for 22 yards.
